adaptations: Loopback-only listener, bounded request count/lifetime and explicit process cleanup.
Repository-audited SDK/runtime lock instead of the upstream example's historical dependency lock.
Existing owned identity policy and a separately credentialed observer on the same deployment.
Explicit JSON Schema 2020-12 conversion, valid SSE framing, JSON-RPC notification silence and malformed-request rejection.
The error test keeps its default failure behavior and exposes fail=false as a genuine positive operation control.
Capability-dependent sampling performs a real bounded client-input workflow after capability admission.
reference.scope: Locally adapted synthetic reference deployment. This does not certify the untouched upstream example, external providers, an independent enterprise observer, or native MCP clients.
reference.reproducibility: Source and raw qualification artifacts were retained outside the repository with the hashes above. This receipt is a summary, not a turnkey reference-server distribution.

inputs.binding: Each run used official evidence for its endpoint and a signed identity selection for the same independently reserved run, target and route.
inputs.positiveInputs: Explicit tool/prompt arguments and finite exact-match roots, synthetic sampling and form-reply plans. No real model, filesystem discovery or automatic user consent.
inputs.faultControl: The unchanged official tools-call-error scenario passed while native positive execution used the separately declared fail=false argument.

controls.evidence: Receiver-side request counters before and after the rejected CLI invocation.

verification.credentialRedaction: Ephemeral target/observer credentials and signing private keys were absent from retained artifacts.
verification.priorFailures: Earlier malformed reference responses, insufficient time budgets and mismatched reply plans were retained as diagnostics rather than relabeled passing.

releaseBoundary: This qualifies the stated local assessment path. Final repository checks, protected PR checks, review resolution and publication approvals remain separate prerequisites.
